intersections.note: Ernst (40 ft, from the NNW) ends at State Av. (60 ft, NE-SW) in an acute Y; point where the two centrelines meet, at the junction of the two water pipes, below the apex of the block corners (Ernst W face / State NW face corner at 3672,2962; Ernst E face / State NW face corner at 3831,2625). Fire alarm box 94 just north of it (also drawn on sheet 505)

APPROXIMATE (about +-40 px): the crossing sits at the top paper edge and Harrison's block faces are not drawn west of the tracks, only its 14 in. water pipe (y about 195) and the D.H./fire alarm box 66. Point is where the State Av. centreline (straight, extended from its faces at y 1000-3000) meets the Harrison pipe line, averaged with the position implied by the State/Harrison corner as drawn on sheet 505 (where this junction is fully drawn at 2778,7348)

bends.note: Prospect runs N-S (x about 780) from the top edge to here, then turns SW and leaves the left edge at y about 6000-6500

ends.note: north end of Jean St. (lower left, SE of Prospect and diverging from it to the SW) at a lot line behind the Prospect frontage; does not reach Prospect. Only this stub is drawn; the rest is on sheet 492 (beyond the dash-dot line A-B)

notes: Two street intersections: Ernst/State Av. (well defined) and State Av./Harrison Av. at the top edge (approximate, see its note). One panel. Streets: Prospect (40 ft) down the left side, labelled PROSPECT only (the key map shows Prospect Av.); Ernst (40 ft, label ERNST, key map Ernst St.) from the top edge (x about 3000-3200) SSE to State Av.; State Av. (60 ft) diagonally NE-SW across the sheet; Jean St. as a short stub at the lower left. Harrison Av. is only grazed along the top edge: label, 14 in. water pipe (y about 195) and, east of the tracks, the south frontage of lots 1369/1363 (slanted from 5720,330 to 5900,240, then y about 235); its north side is off the paper. State Av.'s block faces stop short of Harrison (NW face ends at 4840,355, SE face at the lot 2024 corner 5115,705) and the gap is open ground crossed by the C.H.&D. tracks; the State Av. water pipe turns north at x about 5030 to the D.H. on the Harrison pipe. The long lines between Prospect and Ernst at the top and west of Prospect are lot lines, not streets. The dash-dot lines C-D (top, toward sheet 505) and A-B (bottom left, toward sheet 492) are sheet-match lines. East of State Av. the sheet is C.H.&D. railroad yard, the freight depot and the Mill Creek: no streets; the 4 in./3 in. water pipe running south from Harrison at x about 5520 lies in railroad ground, not a street.
